articles.title: World : US Expels Cuban Diplomat After Confrontation At UN Debate
articles.description: NEW YORK, Oct 29 (Bernama-dpa) -- The United States (US) has expelled a Cuban diplomat following a heated exchange at the United Nations (UN), in a further sign of the deteriorating relationship between Washington and Havana, German Press Agency (dpa) reported.
